author: AbhisekBasu1
name: 11L FixedCkpt + G384 Packed Init
blurb: Packaged fixed-checkpoint g384 reproduction on Modal 8xH100 SXM using a bundled init_model.ptz plus bundled prepacked_sbev.bin. Eval-only export path (ITERATIONS=0) reproduces the current best honest non-TTT g384 line at 1.12134430 sliding-window exact under the 16,000,000-byte cap. This is leaderboard-track, but not a new SOTA claim against merged PR #549 at 1.1194.
